description: This PHP source file defines the 'SsoTokenProvider' class in the AWS SDK, responsible for managing SSO tokens, including loading, refreshing, and validating tokens from AWS SSO profiles.

classes.name: SsoTokenProvider
classes.description: Implements token fetching and refreshing from AWS SSO profiles, handling token storage, validation, and refresh logic.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the SsoTokenProvider with specified profile name, config file path, and optional SSO OIDC client.

methods.name: resolveProfileName
methods.description: Resolves the profile name to use based on argument, environment variable, or default.

methods.name: resolveConfigFile
methods.description: Determines the configuration file path from argument or default location.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Loads, validates, and returns the SSO token asynchronously.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Refreshes the SSO token if conditions are met using the SSO OIDC client.

methods.name: shouldAttemptRefresh
methods.description: Determines whether a token refresh should be attempted based on timing and expiry.

methods.name: getTokenLocation
methods.description: Generates a path to the cached token file based on the sso_session.

methods.name: getTokenData
methods.description: Reads and decodes the token data from the token file.

methods.name: validateTokenData
methods.description: Validates presence and correctness of essential token data properties.

methods.name: writeNewTokenDataToDisk
methods.description: Writes updated token data back to the disk, updating expiration time.
